statistics.estimator: chain-preserving joint complex phase/numerator jackknife; separate group sample weights
statistics.criterion: complete blocking-sensitive four-observable 95-percent interval inside target
statistics.auxiliary: fine-chain time, chain, phase, numerical and blocking diagnostics; no new isolated 3-sigma veto

conditional_second_order.interval: linear propagation of the same difference intervals divided by -3
conditional_second_order.limitation: two steps neither establish the asymptotic h^2 regime nor turn this extrapolation into a measured continuum result

stop: exactly four new fine-step chains; no outcome-dependent additions, h=.05, T=12.8, size or coupling scan
